method_notes: Servers: 3183 (frozen, as instructed) and 3184 (same build, NOT frozen). Under --frozen, officer and collector sessions are rejected by middleware (redirect to /login) because the staff token is issued with frozen-clock iat+12h but checked against the real clock; so staff pages were run on 3184. This is a harness artifact, not logged as an app bug. React error #425 seen on /citizen in the frozen run only (axe-core-frozen3183 file); not reproduced on 3184.
